items.markdown:
![Free User Persona Template & Examples | Xtensio](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081545-2633-0066-0000-df5a5dd32caf:13)
You can build a research-backed profile using the [Canva User Persona Templates](https://www.canva.com/templates/s/user-persona/) to visualize audience experiences and motivations.[[1]](https://www.canva.com/templates/s/user-persona/)

A user persona is a data-driven profile that represents a key segment of your target audience. It helps product, design, and marketing teams understand user needs, behaviors, and pain points.[[1]](https://xtensio.com/user-persona-template/)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/templates/user-persona-template/)

### Core Sections of a User Persona Template

- **Profile & Identity** : Include a realistic photo, a fictional name, and a specific job title or role.
- **Demographics** : List details like age, location, education, income, and family status.
- **Bio & Quote** : Write a short summary of their background and a direct quote that captures their mindset.
- **Goals & Motivations** : Detail what success looks like and what drives their purchasing or usage decisions.
- **Frustrations & Pain Points** : Outline specific obstacles or daily challenges that get in their way.
- **Preferred Channels** : Note where they spend time online or how they prefer to communicate.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence/templates/persona)[[2]](https://xtensio.com/user-persona-template/)[[3]](https://www.mural.co/templates/user-personas)

Other popular options for digital canvases include the [Figma User Persona Template](https://www.figma.com/community/file/881830156311997001/user-persona-template) and [Miro Persona Templates](https://miro.com/templates/persona/).[[1]](https://miro.com/templates/persona/)[[2]](https://www.figma.com/community/file/881830156311997001/user-persona-template)If you'd like, let me know:

- What **product or service** you are building for
- What **type of data** you already have from your users

I can help you outline the specific questions or categories to include in your template.
